Name: Infernus Hellhorn
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: When a beast is exposed to the elemental energy of the Elemental Plane of Fire for long enough, it may adapt and be twisted into an elemental monstrosity. Infused with flame and an undying rage, these creatures lash out at all life around them as though seeking retribution for the eternal pain they experience.

traits.name: Burning Aura
traits.description: If the hellhorn is hit by a melee attack from within 5 feet, the attacker takes 5 (1d8) fire damage. A creature grappling, being grappled by, or in contact with the hellhorn at the beginning of their turn also takes this damage.

traits.name: Charging Takedown
traits.description: If the hellhorn moves at least 15 feet in a straight line toward a creature and then makes a Gore attack against it, the attack has advantage and the target takes an additional 9 (2d8) piercing damage on a successful hit. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Monstrous Fury (1/Rest)
traits.description: When the hellhorn falls below half its hit point maximum, its body ignites with greater flames. While in this state, each time it makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it rolls 1d4 and adds it to the result, and all piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning damage it takes is reduced by 5. It remains in this state for 1 minute then returns to normal.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hellhorn attacks once each with its Gore and Hooves.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Taurian Meteor (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hellhorn is wreathed in flames and teleports into an unoccupied space it can see within 90 feet. An explosion erupts from that space, forcing all creatures within 10 feet of the hellhorn in its new space to make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures who fail by 5 points or more are ignited.

reactions.name: Burning Shield (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: When targeted by a weapon attack, the hellhorn creates a shell of flames around it that lasts until the start of its next turn. While it exists, the hellhorn’s AC is increased by 5, and its Burning Aura damage increases by 5 (1d8).
